decisions.reason: The comfort insole fits the firm's foot-measurement and footwear knowledge and adds to its accessory range, but as a simple accessory that overlaps with the other insoles it is a likely candidate for consolidation.

The supportive insole draws on the firm's ergonomic and measurement expertise, so its value can be interpreted and improved in-house, though overlap with the flagship moulded insole raises some risk of consolidation.
The ergonomic safety shoe series sits at the heart of the firm's core competence and in-house development, giving it strong capacity to learn from results and refine the line.

As the flagship that ties together the firm's measurement tools, training services and footwear knowledge, the moulded insole is strategically central and well supported by the firm's existing know-how.
